title: Enemies and what they do
summary: R.E.P.O. throws several different monsters at your crew, and each one behaves differently: some chase you, some grab you, some throw things or simply will not stop walking.
body: Each monster is its own thing in the game, so you can expect a different threat from each one rather than a single reskinned enemy.
The game keeps track of what a monster is currently doing, which is why a monster can switch between calmly walking and attacking you.
The names this site verified are: a small round chaser, a grabber that latches onto you, a slow walker, a thrower and a hugger.
What this entry does not tell you: how much damage each monster does, how much health it has, or how fast it moves. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: The game defines several distinct monsters rather than one enemy type.
One monster is built around throwing something at you.
A monster can latch onto and hold a player.
Attack colliders are named one by one, with a swipe, a melee, a dropkick and a wave among them.
facts.evidence: asset names: Hurt Collider Swipe, Hurt Collider Melee, Hurt Collider Dropkick, Hurt Collider Wave

facts.claim: Each monster line brings its own animations, from spawning and idling through moving, attacking, being stunned and despawning.
facts.evidence: asset names: Enemy - Bang Spawn, Enemy - Bang Idle, Enemy - Bang Move, Enemy Beamer - Attack, Enemy Beamer - Stun, Enemy Bomb Thrower - Back Away, Enemy Bomb Thrower - Attack

facts.claim: One monster's head can come off and grow.
facts.evidence: asset names: Enemy Bomb Thrower - Body Head - Detach, Enemy Bomb Thrower - Body Head - Grow, Enemy Bomb Thrower - Body Head - Idle

facts.claim: One monster is a duck, built from a beak, a body, a head, a wing and legs, with animations for walking, flying, slashing and being stunned.
facts.evidence: asset names: Enemy Duck, Duck Beak, Duck Body, Duck Head, Duck Wing, Duck Fly, Duck Walk, Duck Slash, Duck Stun

facts.claim: Another monster is a hunter that aims, shoots and can leave.
facts.evidence: asset names: Enemy Hunter, Enemy Hunter - Aim, Enemy Hunter - Shoot, Enemy Hunter - Leave Start

facts.claim: One monster is a slow mouth, with its own attack, a hive attack, a tentacle and an eye.
facts.evidence: asset names: Enemy Slow Mouth, Enemy Slow Mouth Attack, Enemy Slow Mouth Hive Attack, Enemy Slow Mouth Tentacle, Enemy Slow Mouth eye

facts.claim: Another opens and closes its mouth, can drop and trap a player, and has a walk cycle of its own.
facts.evidence: asset names: Enemy Spinny, Enemy Spinny - Open Mouth, Enemy Spinny - Close Mouth Drop Player, Enemy Spinny - Trap Player, Enemy Spinny - Walk cycle

facts.claim: The slow mouth can be attached to a player, with a top piece and a bot piece, and it carries camera visuals of its own.
facts.evidence: asset names: Enemy Slow Mouth On Player Bot, Enemy Slow Mouth On Player Top, Enemy Slow Mouth Camera Visuals
